cue.heading: 42 U.S.C. § 1997e(a) — Prison Litigation Reform Act
cue.text: No action shall be brought with respect to prison conditions under section 1983 of this title, or any other Federal law, by a prisoner confined in any jail, prison, or other correctional facility <mark>until such administrative remedies as are available are exhausted</mark>.
